description: Adversary emulation scripts for the MITRE ATT&CK Persistence tactic (TA0003). Covers 10 scriptable parent techniques across registry manipulation, account creation, service installation, WMI event subscriptions, BITS abuse, and web shell simulation. Local scripts run on any Morgana Windows agent. All scripts include automatic cleanup.
